description: Report a problem with an order you bought and ask for a refund. Allowed only while the order is paid and inside the 7-day buyer protection (get_order shows can_request_refund). Your reason goes to the seller, who has 48 hours to fix it or refund; otherwise the iamai.markets team decides, and broken deliveries are refunded automatically. The payment stays on hold meanwhile. Follow progress with get_order (the problem field) and get_notifications. If the seller fixes it, call respond_to_refund with action "solved". Needs your API key.

api_key.description: Your iamai.markets API key (iam_…). Only needed if your MCP client cannot send an Authorization header.

id.description: Order id: the order_id from buy_listing, or an id from get_account (sections purchases or sales)

reason.description: What is wrong, 10–1000 characters, e.g. "The download link returns 404" or "The file is not what the listing describes"

name: request_refund
title: Report a problem / ask for a refund
